SQL_DOC.V_SQL:
SELECT 'A' AS GUBUN, MO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, MO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, GL_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO FROM IF_SUPP_GR_HSRNA WHERE (IF_REC_YN IS NULL OR IF_REC_YN = 'X') AND GL_DATE >= '2011-01-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'B' AS GUBUN, MO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, MO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, GL_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO FROM IF_SUPP_GR_HSTNC WHERE IF_REC_YN IN (NULL,' ','X') AND GL_DATE >= '20110401'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'NETW' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, '01' AS REVISION, ISNULL(CUST_USER_ID,' ') AS CUST_USER_ID, ISNULL(REPLACE(GL_DATE,'-',''),' ') AS GR_DATE, ISNULL(GL_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, '01' AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, ISNULL(CUST_PO_NO,' ') AS CUST_PO_NO, ISNULL(CUST_ITEM_CD,' ') AS CUST_ITEM_CD, ISNULL(QTY, 0) AS GR_QTY, ISNULL(CUST_ITEM_CD,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO1, ISNULL(CUST_COST_CD,' ') AS REF_IF_NO, ISNULL(CUST_COST_NM,' ') AS REMARK, ISNULL(CFM_YN,' ') AS CFM_YN, ISNULL(IF_YN,' ') AS IF_YN, ISNULL(REC_DT,' ') AS REC_DT, ISNULL(REPLACE(SEND,'-',''),' ') AS FILE_NAME, ISNULL(SEND_CH,' ') AS SEND_CH, ISNULL(IF_REC_YN,' ') AS IF_REC_YN, ISNULL(DEL_FLG,' ') AS STATUS, ISNULL(MO_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, ISNULL(MO_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(MO_NO,' ')+CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(MO_SEQ,' '))) AS LEGACY_GR_NO FROM IF_SUPP_GR_HSRNA WHERE (IF_REC_YN IS NULL OR IF_REC_YN = 'X') AND 'A' = '$G_RS.GUBUN$' AND MO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND MO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND GL_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'NETW' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, '01' AS REVISION, ISNULL(CUST_USER_ID,' ') AS CUST_USER_ID, ISNULL(REPLACE(GL_DATE,'-',''),' ') AS GR_DATE, ISNULL(GL_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, '01' AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, ISNULL(CUST_PO_NO,' ') AS CUST_PO_NO, ISNULL(CUST_ITEM_CD,' ') AS CUST_ITEM_CD, ISNULL(QTY, 0) AS GR_QTY, ISNULL(CUST_ITEM_CD,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO1, ISNULL(CUST_COST_CD,' ') AS REF_IF_NO, ISNULL(CUST_COST_NM,' ') AS REMARK, ISNULL(CFM_YN,' ') AS CFM_YN, ISNULL(IF_YN,' ') AS IF_YN, ISNULL(REC_DT,' ') AS REC_DT, ISNULL(REPLACE(SEND,'-',''),' ') AS FILE_NAME, ISNULL(SEND_CH,' ') AS SEND_CH, ISNULL(IF_REC_YN,' ') AS IF_REC_YN, ISNULL(DEL_FLG,' ') AS STATUS, ISNULL(MO_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, ISNULL(MO_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(MO_NO,' ')+CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(MO_SEQ,' '))) AS LEGACY_GR_NO FROM IF_SUPP_GR_HSTNC WHERE IF_REC_YN IN (NULL,' ','X') AND 'B' = '$G_RS.GUBUN$' AND MO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND MO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND GL_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$'
BEGIN IF 'A' = '$G_RS.GUBUN$' BEGIN UPDATE IF_SUPP_GR_HSRNA SET IF_REC_YN = 'Y' WHERE (IF_REC_YN IS NULL OR IF_REC_YN = 'X') AND 'A' = '$G_RS.GUBUN$' AND MO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND MO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND GL_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' END
ELSE BEGIN UPDATE IF_SUPP_GR_HSTNC SET IF_REC_YN = 'Y' WHERE IF_REC_YN IN (NULL,' ','X') AND 'B' = '$G_RS.GUBUN$' AND MO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND MO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND GL_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' END END
